text:
Predicates:
PublishingHouse(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
Specialize(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Publish(x, y) ::: x publishes y.
TranslatedFrom(y, z) ::: y is translated from z.
InLanguage(y, z) ::: y is in language z.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.

Premises:
PublishingHouse(newVesselPress) ∧ Specialize(newVesselPress, translatingForeignLiteratureIntoEnglish) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house which specializes in translating foreign literature into English.
∀x (Publish(newVesselPress, x) → InLanguage(x, english)) ::: All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
Book(neapolitanChronicles) ∧ Publish(newVesselPress, neapolitanChronicles) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
Book(palaceOfFlies) ∧ Publish(newVesselPress, palaceOfFlies) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.

Conclusion:
InLanguage(neapolitanChronicles, english) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is an English book.
